transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um… I guess I’m here because things have been getting on top of me. I tried to make my art into more of a real freelance business, and since then I get really wound up about invoices or client messages. Then I put them off, and it sort of builds until I’m crying at the kitchen table or forgetting basic things, like paying a bill.
Do you find yourself having recurring thoughts or urges that you can't seem to get rid of, even if you try to ignore them or distract yourself?
I don’t think so… not in that way. I mean, I do get stuck on things sometimes, but I’m not sure it’s like thoughts or urges I can’t get rid of.
Are the things you get stuck on more like worries or fears that you can’t seem to control, even when you wish you could?

Yeah… more like worries, I guess. It’s mostly since I tried to make my art into a proper freelance thing. I get really wound up over invoices or client messages, and then I avoid them until it gets… a lot. Like crying at the kitchen table, or forgetting normal stuff like paying a bill.
Do you find that your worrying happens more days than not, and that it’s difficult to control, even when there isn’t a specific problem that needs solving?

I’m not sure. It doesn’t feel like it’s just there all the time for no reason… it’s more when something specific comes up, or I think something might be waiting for me. Then it’s hard to switch off, but I don’t know about more days than not.
Do you find that you feel anxious or worried most days, even when there isn’t a specific problem that needs solving right away?

Not really most days for no reason, I don’t think. It’s more tied to the freelance art stuff… invoices, client messages. If I know something’s waiting for me, I get wound up and then avoid it until it kind of falls apart.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy, especially related to your art or freelance work?
I don’t know… I haven’t really thought of it as hopeless exactly. I still care about my art. It’s just harder to deal with the work side of it sometimes.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, even things like your art or other hobbies?
I don’t think so… not in a clear way. I still like doing art when I can get into it. I guess I just haven’t been paying close attention to whether it feels different.
Have you been feeling down or sad on most days, even when there isn’t a specific problem with your freelance work or other obligations?
I don’t think it’s most days. I mean, I have low moments, but I haven’t really noticed being sad when nothing’s going on.
Have you noticed that you’ve lost interest in doing things you used to enjoy, including your art or other hobbies, even when you’re not stressed about work or bills?
I don’t think I’ve really noticed that. If I’m not stressed about work or money, I can still get interested in things… at least, I think so.
Do you find that you worry or feel anxious on days when there’s no immediate problem with your freelance work or other obligations?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I notice feeling anxious when there isn’t something specific going on… but I might not always be paying attention to it.
Do you find that you feel anxious or on edge most days, even when there isn't anything specific happening with your work or other responsibilities?
I don’t think so… not most days. It’s more like if something’s actually going on. Otherwise I don’t really notice it.
Do you ever find yourself feeling anxious or worried about things other than your freelance work, like everyday responsibilities or situations that other people might not think much about?

Mostly it’s the freelance stuff. Like invoices, client messages… trying to make the art into an actual business. I’ll get really wound up and then avoid it, and then it turns into me crying at the kitchen table or forgetting something normal, like a bill.
Do you ever feel down, sad, or lose interest in things you used to enjoy, even when there isn’t anything stressful going on with your freelance work or other responsibilities?
I don’t really know. I haven’t noticed that happening when nothing stressful is going on… it’s hard for me to separate it out, I guess.

Do you ever feel anxious or worried about things outside of your freelance work, like everyday tasks, social situations, or other parts of your life, even when other people might not see them as a big deal?

Not really outside of that, I don’t think. It’s mostly since I tried to make my art into an actual freelance business… invoices, client messages, that kind of thing. I get wound up and then avoid it, and then it sort of spills over, like I’m crying at the kitchen table or forgetting a normal bill.
Do you feel down, lose interest in things, or feel hopeless on most days, even when there’s nothing particularly stressful going on with your freelance work?
I don’t think so. I mean, I have bad days, but I haven’t really noticed it happening most days when there isn’t some stress around the work stuff.

Do you ever feel anxious or worried about things other than your freelance work, like everyday tasks, social situations, or other parts of your life, even when other people might not see them as a big deal?

Not really… it’s mostly the freelance stuff. Like invoices or client messages. I get really wound up about them and then put them off, and then it kind of turns into me crying at the kitchen table or forgetting regular things, like a bill.
Do you ever feel down, lose interest in things, or feel hopeless even when there isn’t anything stressful going on with your freelance work?
I don’t think so. I haven’t really noticed that happening when the work stress isn’t there.
Do you often feel tired or like you don’t have any energy, even when there isn’t any particular stress going on with your freelance work?
I don’t think so. I mean, I get tired like anyone, but I haven’t really noticed it happening when there isn’t work stress going on.
Do you ever feel anxious or worried about things outside of your freelance work, like everyday tasks or situations that others might not think much about?

Not really outside of that. It’s mostly since I tried to make my art into freelance work… the invoices and client messages get me really wound up, and then I avoid them until it becomes a whole thing. Like crying at the kitchen table, or forgetting normal stuff like a bill.
